title: A Restless Night
content: I claimed my usual corner of the bed last night, but my itchy ears kept interrupting my sleep. I scratched them and shook my head a lot. My human sat with me for a while before we finally settled down.

title: An Easy Morning
content: My human checked my ears while we sat together this morning. They were clean and comfortable, and I didn’t scratch them once. Then I took over the warm spot they left on the bed.

title: A Quiet Evening Together
content: Dinner didn’t sit well with me tonight, and I threw up twice. My human cleaned up and stayed nearby while I curled up in a quiet corner. We had a much slower evening than usual.

title: Dinner, Then Sofa Time
content: I ate my usual dinner and kept everything down, with no upset tummy. Afterward I joined my human on the sofa and tucked my paws underneath me while they read.

title: An Awkward Landing
content: I was following my human around the living room when I jumped off the couch and landed awkwardly. After that I didn’t want to put much weight on my back left leg, so we spent the rest of the evening quietly together.

title: My Hallway Is a Racetrack
content: I walked, jumped, and raced through the hallway this morning without limping. My paws felt great. My human was trying to get ready, but I kept arriving at every doorway before she did.

title: The Window Needed Cleaning
content: I settled beside the dusty window and started sneezing over and over. Once I moved away I felt fine again. My human wiped the sill while I supervised from across the room.

title: An Afternoon Beside My Human
content: My eyes kept watering this afternoon, and I rubbed my face with my paws. My human noticed while I was sitting beside their laptop and paused what they were doing to check on me.

title: Just Not Feeling Playful
content: I spent most of the afternoon asleep. My human brought out my favorite feather wand, but I stayed where I was instead of chasing it. We ended up having a quiet afternoon side by side.

title: Back at the Water Bowl
content: Between following my human around and resting in the hallway, I kept returning to my water bowl. I was drinking noticeably more than usual, and my human wrote it down to keep track.

title: Catio Time Took a Turn
content: I rolled around on the grass in my catio today. Later my belly started itching, and my human noticed a little redness. I came inside and settled nearby while they checked it.

title: One of Those Good Days
content: I ate normally, had plenty of energy, and made time for all my toys today. Nothing seemed to bother me. My human laughed when I carried a toy into the room just as they sat down.

title: Not This Morning
content: My human put down breakfast, but I only sniffed it and walked away without eating a bite. They looked surprised. I sat nearby while they made their own breakfast instead.

title: Could I Have Seconds?
content: I finished every bite of breakfast and meowed for more. My human showed me the empty bowl as if I hadn’t noticed. I stayed close in case another serving appeared.

title: Something Different in My Bowl
content: My human mixed a little salmon kibble into my regular food today. I sniffed the unfamiliar pieces carefully before trying them. They waited beside me to see what I thought.

title: A Treat That Didn’t Agree With Me
content: I tried a new chicken treat today. Soon afterward my neck started itching, and I scratched more than usual. My human put the packet aside and made a note of what I had eaten.

title: Working for My Dinner
content: Dinner came in a puzzle feeder tonight. I had to nudge it around to get each bite, so I ate slowly. My human sat on the floor with me, and I looked very pleased when I finished.

title: I Had Other Dinner Plans
content: My human offered fish-flavored wet food, but I turned up my nose. I happily ate my dry kibble instead. Apparently the fancy dinner was more exciting to them than it was to me.

title: Play First, Dinner Second
content: I spent ages chasing my feather toy and climbing my cat tree. By dinner I was extra hungry and finished my food fast. My human barely had time to sit down before my bowl was empty.

title: A Fresh Refill
content: My human washed my water bowl and refilled it twice today. I enjoyed little sips of the fresh water, then sat nearby while they finished tidying the kitchen.

title: My Little Outdoor Round
content: I explored my catio this morning, sniffing the plants and watching insects crawl past the mesh. My human drank their coffee nearby while I inspected everything at my own pace.

title: The Best Seat in the Room
content: I climbed every level of my cat tree and reached the highest platform. It was an exhausting expedition. From up there I could watch my human moving around the room without leaving my perch.

title: Rain Changed Our Plans
content: It rained outside, so my human rolled a soft ball down the hallway for me to chase. I kept bringing the game back toward them. Our indoor afternoon turned out to be quite exciting.

title: A Very Busy Window
content: I sat safely by the screened window and watched birds hopping around the yard. My tail twitched with excitement. My human joined me for a minute to see what had my attention.

title: My Sunny Seat
content: I spent an hour on the sunny windowsill watching birds. Whenever one flew close, I chirped. My human tried to take a picture, but I was much too busy looking outside to pose.

title: Staying In
content: Rain tapped against the window all afternoon. I skipped my usual catio time and napped inside instead, close enough to hear my human turning the pages of their book.

title: A Game With My Housemate
content: I chased my feline housemate around the living room today. We took turns hiding behind the couch and jumping back into the game. My human lifted their feet to let us race past.

title: My Evening Burst of Energy
content: Just after sunset I sprinted around the apartment, slid around corners, and leaped onto the sofa. My human had just settled down for the evening. I clearly had different plans.

title: We Learned Something Together
content: My human taught me to jump over a tiny obstacle for a treat. I managed it twice. They sounded so pleased that I stayed nearby to see whether we would try again.

title: The Dot Got Away Again
content: I chased a little red dot around the living room for ten minutes. My human finished the game with a toy I could actually catch. I held onto my prize while they put everything away.

title: A Loud Evening
content: A loud thunderclap sent me under the table. I stayed hidden and trembled until it grew quiet. My human sat nearby, and I came out when I felt ready.

title: Too Cozy to Notice
content: Thunder rumbled outside while I slept peacefully in my favorite basket. The noise didn’t bother me. My human checked on me, but I barely opened my eyes.

title: You’re Finally Back
content: When my human came home, I ran to the door with my tail high and greeted them with loud meows. They put down their bag and spent a few minutes with me before doing anything else.

title: Who Rang the Bell?
content: The delivery driver rang the bell, and I dashed to the hallway to investigate. I watched cautiously from a distance while my human collected the package. Once the door closed, I inspected the box.

title: Too Much Company Today
content: Unfamiliar visitors came over today, and I hid behind the sofa until everyone left. My human let me keep my distance. When the room was quiet again, I returned to my usual spot.

title: A Nice Afternoon With Guests
content: I calmly approached our visitors and sniffed their hands. Then I curled up beside them on the couch while everyone talked. My human seemed happy that I wanted to join in.

title: That Wasn’t My Toy
content: I found a sneaker and started chewing its loose shoelace. My human took it away and gave me a safe toy instead. I carried the replacement off as though that had been my plan all along.

title: Twenty Whole Seconds
content: My human asked me to stay on my mat. I waited for twenty whole seconds before earning a treat. They looked proud, and I was ready to find out whether waiting again would earn another one.

title: A Visit About My Ears
content: My human took me to the veterinarian because my ears were itchy. The vet looked inside and said I had an ear infection. We brought home the prescribed treatment, and I rested in my familiar corner afterward.

title: A Quick Trip Out
content: I visited the veterinary clinic for routine vaccinations today. I wasn’t thrilled about the carrier, but I got treats afterward. Once we were home, I went straight to my usual resting spot.

title: Taking It Slowly
content: The veterinarian examined my left hind leg after I started limping and recommended a few days of rest. Back home my human stayed near me, and we traded our usual busy evening for a quiet one.

title: Home After the Dentist
content: I had my teeth professionally cleaned at the veterinary clinic. After coming home I rested quietly and recovered well. My human kept me company while I took it easy.

title: Someone Checked My Eyes
content: The veterinarian examined my watery eyes and talked with my human about possible irritation. When we got home, I settled down near them while they put away the carrier.

title: An Ordinary Checkup
content: I had my annual wellness exam today. The veterinarian said everything looked normal, and my human seemed relieved. Coming home to all my familiar things was my favorite part.

title: A Little Birthday Celebration
content: Today was my third birthday. My human gave me a new mouse toy and a special cat-safe treat. They took pictures while I investigated my presents at my own pace.

title: Getting to Know This Place
content: I explored my new apartment slowly, sniffing every corner. My human gave me space and let me choose where to go. Eventually I felt safe enough to curl up in my new bed.

title: This Blanket Is Mine Now
content: My human gave me a fleece blanket. I kneaded it with my paws and slept on it all afternoon. They had put it beside them, which made it an especially good place to settle.

title: Did Someone Call Me?
content: My human called my name from across the room, and I ran right over. I earned a treat for coming when called. After that I stayed nearby, listening very carefully for my name again.

title: A Whole Year Together
content: It’s been one year since I was adopted. My human took lots of pictures while I lounged in my favorite spot. We spent a quiet evening together, which felt like a lovely way to celebrate.

title: Looking a Little Tidier
content: My human brushed my fur and carefully trimmed my nails today. I looked extra tidy afterward. When we were finished, I stretched out beside them and got back to doing very little.

title: Relaxing Evening
content: This is the moment I love most, when my human brushed me from head to tail with three different brushes. I purred loudly and felt completely relaxed.
